name: Nomic Embed: Training a Reproducible Long Context Text Embedder
problem: Open embedding models could not be reproduced because training data and code were withheld, and long-context embedders were weak.
mechanism: Matryoshka-trained long-context embedder (learns to prefix-truncate to any shorter context length) with LoRA adapters applied to a causal LLM; the full curated training data and code are released so the model can be replicated end to end. Long inputs are truncated from the middle, not the end.
speedup_reported: Claims to outperform OpenAI ada-002 and text-embedding-3-small on both the short-context MTEB benchmark and the long-context LoCo benchmark, at 8192 context length. Vendor self-reported comparison against closed APIs with no cost or latency disclosure - this is a quality claim only.
notes:
Venue TMLR (Semantic Scholar records 'Trans. Mach. Learn. Res.'; the arXiv comment links the OpenReview forum IPmzyQSiQE). The schema has no TMLR entry so 'other' is used. THE MECHANISM WORTH STEALING IS MATRYOSHKA + MIDDLE-TRUNCATION: a single checkpoint serves every context length by truncation, which means one set of weights serves short-query and long-document embeddings instead of two models. For serving that halves resident weight memory per embedding index.
